purpose: Expand all 30 frozen novelty-first strict six-frame rescue sequences against the complete Stage05F1 annotation-independent unique peptide universe, then identify replicated and longer stop-to-stop homologs for later locus/full-ORF reconstruction.
target_universe: Stage05F1 annotation-independent six-frame unique peptides from all frozen 3674 dual-arm candidate +/-10 kb neighborhoods
core_homolog_rule: non-exact target AND evalue <= 1e-5 AND qcov >= 0.70 AND fident >= 0.25
broad_homolog_sensitivity_rule: non-exact target AND evalue <= 1e-3 AND qcov >= 0.50
major_extension_rule: longer target AND target_length >= max(180, 1.5 * query_length)
claim_boundary: Sequence-family expansion within the frozen Stage05F1 six-frame neighborhood universe. A homolog, longer stop-to-stop peptide, formal RVT profile carried forward from F1, or replication does not establish biochemical RT activity or ART identity.
